arabic text: AB TO AJAO SHAHAN SHAHE WAFA
english translation text: PLEASE COME BACK OH KING OF LOYALTY

arabic text: RORO KEHTI THI SAKINA RANME\nLUTGAYI SANIYE ZEHRA KI RIDA
english translation text: SAKINA WAS CRYING FROM THE DESERT\nTHEY HAVE TAKEN AWAY BIBI ZAINAB’S VEIL

arabic text: SHIMR NE MARE TAMACHE HAI MERE GALON PE\nJHIRKIYAN DAY KE UTHAYA HAI MUJHE\nBABA KI LAASH PE RONE NA DIYA
english translation text: SHIMR HAS SLAPPED MY CHEEKS\nTHEY HAVE PICKED ME UP WITH FORCE\nTHEY DID NOT LET ME CRY OVER MY FATHER’S BODY

arabic text: CHEEN KAR SAB KI RIDAYEN AUR JALAYE KHAIME\nAYSE LOOTA HAI MUSALMANO NE\nNA KIYA AALE MUHAMMAD KA HAYA
english translation text: THEY SNATCHED ALL OUR VEILS AND BURNT OUR TENTS\nTHE WAY THEY HAVE LOOTED THE MUSLIMS IN THIS WAY\nTHEY DIDN’T THINK WE ARE FROM NABI’S FAMILY

arabic text: TUMKO ABBAS KI TAQAT PE BHAROSA THA BOHOT\nQAID HONE SE BACHAEY TUMKO\nAAKE YE SHIMR NE ZAINAB SE KAHA
english translation text: YOU HAD A LOT OF FAITH IN THE STRENGTH OF ABBAS\nTHAT HE WOULD SAVE YOU FROM BEING IMPRISONED\n…SHIMR HAD SAID THIS TO ZAINAB

arabic text: SHAAM JANE KAY LIYE QAFILA TAYYAR HAI JO\nUN ME IK RAAT KI BYAAHI HAI KHARI\nHAATHON SE UTRA NAHIN RANGE HINA
english translation text: THE CARAVAN THAT IS READY TO GO TO SHAAM\nTHERE IS A NEW BRIDE IN THERE AS WELL\nTHE COLOUR OF HENA HAS NOT LEFT HER HANDS

arabic text: TOR DI MAAR KE AKBAR KE JIGAR ME BARCHHI\nAUR SITAMGAR NE KAHA MOLA SE\nYE SUNA HAI KE TU SABIR HAI BARA
english translation text: THE ASSASSIN THEN TAUNTED MOLA HUSSAIN\nAFTER BREAKING THE SPEAR TIP IN AKBAR’S HEART\nSAYING, CAN YOUR PATIENCE BEAR THIS TRAGEDY?

arabic text: SAHIBUL ASR YE ALFAAZ ATA KARTE HAI\nKOI KHOOBI YE NAHIN AKHTAR KI\nISS KE NAWHO ME HAI ZEHRA KI DUA
english translation text: IMAM ZAMANA IS SAYING\nTHERE IS NO WEIGHT IN 'AKHTAR’S' WORDS\nWITHOUT THE DUA OF BIBI FATEMA
